invariants.name: EVERY_GENERATED_INPUT_HAS_PRODUCER
invariants.note: Strengthened by this programme: a producer must now be an IDENTIFIED OBJECT, not merely a declared path string. Before assimilation all 29 declared producers were anonymous.

invariants.name: EVERY_GENERATED_INPUT_HAS_BOOTSTRAP_PATH
invariants.note: Pre-existing DECLARED-OPEN condition, recorded by the generated-artifact registry itself in `bootstrap_gaps`. Not introduced by this programme. Measured by reading the bootstrap script rather than trusting the registry's own claim — which also showed the registry's gap note to be STALE: provenance_engine.py IS invoked, so realization/ is the only true gap.

invariants.name: NO_ARCHITECTURE_DEPENDS_ON_FINITE_INSTANCE
invariants.note: UCOS-ACFV-000001 and the constitutional corpus discuss finite domains as EXAMPLES; naming one in prose is not a dependency. The invariant is meaningful only where a finite instance could become STRUCTURAL — in the keys, classes and rules of the foundation itself. Scanning prose would produce noise and would gate on discussion rather than on architecture.
